test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘APPRECIATE’ is written as ‘ETAICERPPA’, ‘MOTIVATION’ is written as ‘NOITAVITOM’. How will ‘FRIENDSHIP’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Letters are written in the reverse order within the word.

​So,

 
• ‘APPRECIATE’ is written as ‘ETAICERPPA’

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/261724da7cc70ebc8014314a1d4199f487f156c9a2cace06bd8bf8c0f7d11081.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘MOTIVATION’ is written as ‘NOITAVITOM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9b29ce44c1faf968faa2333cf5ad9ac88eda987dbaeb153a7f356a887a68bd1.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘FRIENDSHIP’ is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0094e73c65d0e4fe1ce86dfc52adc79bfa7a7d23f38f2c454ff32ac1d72e3948.png] 

Hence, **"PIHSDNEIRF"** is the correct answer.

6b:T85
